A1.justification: Both complete, readable 20-page PDFs describe pFedMoAP and contain the same main sections and Appendix A. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original image-classification experiments across nine datasets, with benchmark results in Tables 1–4 and additional privacy experiments and ablations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains these original benchmark results, differential-privacy experiments, and ablations in the main text and Appendix A.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same prompt-expert pool, KNN expert selection, attention-based gating, training procedure, and combination of local and MoE logits.

E1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix A retain the same nine image-classification datasets and the same few-shot, label-shift, combined feature/label-shift, and differential-privacy scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment. Table 1 retains ZS-CLIP, CoOp, PromptFL, adapted FL methods, pFedPrompt, and FedOTP; the other main and appendix comparisons also retain their original rows.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A preserve the same data partitions, client counts, participation rates, CLIP backbones, training budgets, accuracy metric, and differential-privacy settings.

E4.justification: The shot-count and local-logit-weight studies in Section 5.3 are unchanged. Appendix A retains identical analyses of differential privacy, gating architecture and aggregation, expert count, feature dimension, and expert contributions.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over three runs with different seeds in Section 5.2. Uncertainty reporting in the main and appendix results is unchanged.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings in Tables 1–4 and 6–9 and Figures 3–6 are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Flowers102 accuracy of 98.41±0.04 for pFedMoAP with λ=0.5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), objective definitions, prompt/MoE formulations, and attention mathematics are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about sharing lightweight prompts, personalized attention-based gating, and effectiveness under heterogeneous federated settings.

C2.justification: Interpretations of gating behavior, privacy, expert-count saturation, and feature-dimension tradeoffs are unchanged, as are the stated limitations. The new NIH/NSF policy disclaimer does not alter scientific interpretations or applicability.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, dataset setup, code-access information, and the Bridges-2 computing-resource disclosure are unchanged. The added NIH contract is funding information rather than a technical or reproducibility detail.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper, and the reference list are unchanged. No prior work is added or removed, and the research positioning remains identical.

P1.justification: Page 12 changes the funding wording to 'supported in part,' adds NIH contract 1OT2OD037972-01, and adds an NIH/NSF policy disclaimer. Page 1 updates the arXiv version/date stamp; research prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded acknowledgments cause local text reflow and tighter vertical spacing on page 12. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts are unchanged; all pages other than 1 and 12 render identically.

improvement.justification: v4 expands the funding acknowledgment and adds an agency-policy disclaimer, with minor local layout changes. These administrative updates leave the scientific content, empirical evidence, clarity of the research exposition, and reproducibility information unchanged, including Appendix A, so overall paper quality does not meaningfully change.
